SELECT pc.id,
    pc.tenant_id,
    pc.academic_year_id,
    pc.label,
    pc.registration_fee,
    pc.late_penalty_per_day,
    pc.second_apron_fee,
    pc.early_payment_bonus_pct,
    pc.early_payment_deadline,
    pc.is_active,
    pc.created_at,
    pc.updated_at,
    ay.label AS academic_year_label
   FROM (pricing_configs pc
     JOIN academic_years ay ON ((ay.id = pc.academic_year_id)))
  WHERE ((pc.is_active = true) AND (ay.is_current = true))
  ORDER BY pc.updated_at DESC;

SELECT entity_type,
    entity_id,
    count(*) AS event_count,
    max(occurred_at) AS last_event_at,
    min(occurred_at) AS first_event_at,
    array_agg(DISTINCT action) AS actions
   FROM audit_logs
  GROUP BY entity_type, entity_id;

SELECT al.id,
    al.tenant_id,
    al.action,
    al.entity_type,
    al.entity_id,
    al.actor_id,
    al.actor_name,
    al.actor_role,
    al.session_id,
    al.before_json,
    al.after_json,
    al.note,
    al.ip_address,
    al.user_agent,
    al.request_id,
    al.supersedes_id,
    al.occurred_at,
    al.created_at,
    up.email AS actor_email,
    up.display_name AS actor_display_name,
    r.label_fr AS actor_role_label
   FROM ((audit_logs al
     LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON ((up.id = al.actor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN roles r ON ((r.code = al.actor_role)));

SELECT e.id,
    e.tenant_id,
    e.academic_year_id,
    e.version_id,
    e.class_id,
    c.code AS class_code,
    c.name AS class_name,
    e.subject_id,
    s.name_fr AS subject_name_fr,
    s.name_ar AS subject_name_ar,
    e.teacher_id,
    ((p.first_name || ' '::text) || p.last_name) AS teacher_name,
    e.room_id,
    r.name AS room_label,
    e.day,
    e.period_index,
    e.start_minutes,
    e.end_minutes,
    e.lesson_group,
    e.notes
   FROM (((((timetable_entries e
     JOIN timetable_versions v ON (((v.id = e.version_id) AND (v.status = 'published'::text))))
     JOIN classes c ON ((c.id = e.class_id)))
     JOIN subjects s ON ((s.id = e.subject_id)))
     LEFT JOIN personnel p ON ((p.id = e.teacher_id)))
     LEFT JOIN rooms r ON ((r.id = e.room_id)))
  WHERE (e.tenant_id = current_tenant_id());

SELECT tenant_id,
    student_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present'::text)) AS present_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'absent_excused'::text)) AS absent_excused_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'absent_unexcused'::text)) AS absent_unexcused_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'late'::text)) AS late_count,
    count(*) AS total_records,
        CASE
            WHEN (count(*) = 0) THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE ((((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'present'::text)))::numeric / (count(*))::numeric) * (100)::numeric))::numeric(5,2)
        END AS attendance_rate_pct
   FROM attendance_records
  GROUP BY tenant_id, student_id;

SELECT tenant_id,
    (occurred_at)::date AS day,
    action,
    count(*) AS event_count
   FROM audit_logs
  GROUP BY tenant_id, ((occurred_at)::date), action
  ORDER BY tenant_id, ((occurred_at)::date) DESC, action;

SELECT calendar_events.tenant_id,
    calendar_events.kind,
    calendar_events.title,
    calendar_events.description,
    calendar_events.start_at,
    calendar_events.end_at,
    calendar_events.all_day,
    calendar_events.location,
    calendar_events.target_entity_type,
    calendar_events.target_entity_id,
    calendar_events.target_name,
    calendar_events.target_phone,
    'manual'::text AS derivation_source,
    calendar_events.created_by,
    calendar_events.created_at
   FROM calendar_events
  WHERE (calendar_events.is_deleted = false)
UNION ALL
 SELECT pay.tenant_id,
    'payment_received'::text AS kind,
    ('Paiement '::text || pay.payment_number) AS title,
    pay.notes AS description,
    pay.collected_at AS start_at,
    (pay.collected_at + '00:01:00'::interval) AS end_at,
    false AS all_day,
    NULL::text AS location,
    'payment'::text AS target_entity_type,
    pay.id AS target_entity_id,
    ((p.last_name || ' '::text) || p.first_name) AS target_name,
    p.primary_phone AS target_phone,
    'system'::text AS derivation_source,
    NULL::uuid AS created_by,
    pay.created_at
   FROM (payments pay
     JOIN parents p ON ((p.id = pay.parent_id)))
  WHERE (pay.status = 'paid'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT et.tenant_id,
    'expense_event'::text AS kind,
    ('Dépense: '::text || et.title) AS title,
    et.description,
    COALESCE(et.disbursed_at, et.approved_at, et.submitted_at) AS start_at,
    (COALESCE(et.disbursed_at, et.approved_at, et.submitted_at) + '00:01:00'::interval) AS end_at,
    false AS all_day,
    NULL::text AS location,
    'expense_ticket'::text AS target_entity_type,
    et.id AS target_entity_id,
    NULL::text AS target_name,
    NULL::text AS target_phone,
    'system'::text AS derivation_source,
    NULL::uuid AS created_by,
    et.created_at
   FROM expense_tickets et
  WHERE (et.status = ANY (ARRAY['approved_funds_released'::text, 'disbursed'::text, 'settled_and_closed'::text]))
UNION ALL
 SELECT al.tenant_id,
    'audit_log'::text AS kind,
    al.action AS title,
    al.note AS description,
    al.occurred_at AS start_at,
    (al.occurred_at + '00:01:00'::interval) AS end_at,
    false AS all_day,
    NULL::text AS location,
    al.entity_type AS target_entity_type,
    al.entity_id AS target_entity_id,
    al.actor_name AS target_name,
    NULL::text AS target_phone,
    'system'::text AS derivation_source,
    al.actor_id AS created_by,
    al.created_at
   FROM audit_logs al
  WHERE (al.action = ANY (ARRAY['expense.approve'::text, 'expense.reject'::text, 'payment.refund'::text, 'workflow.deploy'::text, 'backup.run'::text]));

SELECT tenant_id,
    sku,
    name,
    category,
    quantity_on_hand,
    reorder_level,
    reorder_quantity,
    unit_cost,
    location,
    (reorder_level - quantity_on_hand) AS shortfall
   FROM inventory_items
  WHERE ((quantity_on_hand <= reorder_level) AND (is_active = true) AND (deleted_at IS NULL));

SELECT id AS tenant_id,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM account_approval_requests ar
          WHERE ((ar.tenant_id = t.id) AND (ar.status = 'pending'::text))) AS pending_account_approvals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM expense_tickets et
          WHERE ((et.tenant_id = t.id) AND (et.status = 'pending_approval'::text))) AS pending_expense_approvals,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM leave_requests lr
          WHERE ((lr.tenant_id = t.id) AND (lr.status = 'pending'::text))) AS pending_leave_requests,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM purchase_requests pr
          WHERE ((pr.tenant_id = t.id) AND (pr.status = 'submitted'::text))) AS pending_purchase_requests
   FROM tenants t
  WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL);

SELECT per.tenant_id,
    per.personnel_code,
    ((per.last_name || ' '::text) || per.first_name) AS full_name,
    per.staff_category,
    r.label_fr AS role_label,
    d.name_fr AS department_name,
    per."position",
    per.primary_phone,
    per.email,
    per.hire_date,
    per.is_active
   FROM ((personnel per
     LEFT JOIN roles r ON ((r.id = per.role_id)))
     LEFT JOIN departments d ON ((d.id = per.department_id)))
  WHERE (per.deleted_at IS NULL);

SELECT per.tenant_id,
    per.personnel_code,
    ((per.last_name || ' '::text) || per.first_name) AS full_name,
    per.staff_category,
    r.label_fr AS role_label,
    d.name_fr AS department_name,
    per."position",
    per.primary_phone,
    per.email,
    per.hire_date,
    per.is_active,
    per.base_salary,
    per.payment_method,
    per.bank_account,
    per.bonuses_json
   FROM ((personnel per
     LEFT JOIN roles r ON ((r.id = per.role_id)))
     LEFT JOIN departments d ON ((d.id = per.department_id)))
  WHERE (per.deleted_at IS NULL);

SELECT pc.tenant_id,
    pc.id AS pricing_config_id,
    pc.label,
    ay.label AS academic_year,
    pc.registration_fee,
    pc.late_penalty_per_day,
    pc.second_apron_fee,
    pc.early_payment_bonus_pct,
    pc.early_payment_deadline,
    pc.is_active,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('level_id', glt.academic_level_id, 'level_code', al.grade_code, 'level_label', al.year_label, 'annual_amount', glt.annual_amount, 'tranches', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('number', 1, 'amount', glt.tranche_1_amount, 'month', glt.tranche_1_month), jsonb_build_object('number', 2, 'amount', glt.tranche_2_amount, 'month', glt.tranche_2_month), jsonb_build_object('number', 3, 'amount', glt.tranche_3_amount, 'month', glt.tranche_3_month)))) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (grade_level_tuition glt
             JOIN academic_levels al ON ((al.id = glt.academic_level_id)))
          WHERE (glt.pricing_config_id = pc.id)) AS tuition_by_level,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('destination_id', td.id, 'code', td.code, 'label_fr', td.label_fr, 'annual_amount', td.annual_amount, 'tranches', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('number', 1, 'amount', td.tranche_1_amount, 'month', td.tranche_1_month), jsonb_build_object('number', 2, 'amount', td.tranche_2_amount, 'month', td.tranche_2_month), jsonb_build_object('number', 3, 'amount', td.tranche_3_amount, 'month', td.tranche_3_month)))) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM transport_destinations td
          WHERE (td.pricing_config_id = pc.id)) AS transport_by_destination,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('service_id', cs.id, 'code', cs.code, 'label_fr', cs.label_fr, 'semester_amount', cs.semester_amount, 'annual_amount', cs.annual_amount, 'billing_model', cs.billing_model)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM complementary_services cs
          WHERE ((cs.pricing_config_id = pc.id) AND (cs.is_active = true))) AS complementary_services,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('service_id', ads.id, 'code', ads.code, 'label_fr', ads.label_fr, 'amount', ads.amount, 'billing_model', ads.billing_model)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM additional_services ads
          WHERE ((ads.pricing_config_id = pc.id) AND (ads.is_active = true))) AS additional_services,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('discount_id', d.id, 'code', d.code, 'label_fr', d.label_fr, 'discount_type', d.discount_type, 'amount', d.amount, 'applies_to', d.applies_to)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM discounts d
          WHERE ((d.pricing_config_id = pc.id) AND (d.is_active = true))) AS discounts
   FROM (pricing_configs pc
     JOIN academic_years ay ON ((ay.id = pc.academic_year_id)));

SELECT tenant_id,
    COALESCE(category, 'other'::text) AS category,
    date_trunc('month'::text, collected_at) AS month,
    COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'paid'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS gross_revenue,
    (COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'paid'::text)), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(abs(le.amount)) AS sum
           FROM ledger_entries le
          WHERE ((le.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (le.reverses_id IS NULL) AND (le.parent_id = pay.parent_id) AND (le.category = COALESCE(pay.category, 'other'::text)))), (0)::numeric)) AS net_revenue,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'paid'::text)) AS payment_count
   FROM payments pay
  GROUP BY tenant_id, category, (date_trunc('month'::text, collected_at)), parent_id;

SELECT s.tenant_id,
    s.student_code,
    ((s.last_name || ' '::text) || s.first_name) AS student_name,
    s.date_of_birth,
    s.gender,
    s.enrollment_status,
    s.grade_level_id,
    al.cycle AS academic_cycle,
    al.year_label AS academic_level,
    c.code AS class_code,
    c.name AS class_name,
    p.parent_code,
    ((p.last_name || ' '::text) || p.first_name) AS parent_name,
    p.primary_phone,
    p.email AS parent_email,
    p.relationship,
    p.address,
    p.city
   FROM (((students s
     LEFT JOIN parents p ON ((p.id = s.parent_id)))
     LEFT JOIN classes c ON ((c.id = s.class_id)))
     LEFT JOIN academic_levels al ON ((al.id = s.grade_level_id)))
  WHERE (s.deleted_at IS NULL);
